workbuddy-connections.title: WorkBuddy account authorizations
workbuddy-connections.intro: Manage your WorkBuddy authorization for this project.
workbuddy-connections.boundary: Manage your personal account authorization for this project. Cloud task dispatch and progress belong to the corresponding task or run, with permissions and execution eligibility checked separately.
workbuddy-connections.desktop_opened: The authorization window is open. Connection status will be checked when you return.
workbuddy-connections.desktop_failed: The authorization window could not open. Check the connection status before trying again.
workbuddy-connections.desktop_closed: The authorization window is closed. Check the connection status.
workbuddy-connections.desktop_hint: This desktop does not provide an authorization window. Open Suma in your system browser and sign in to authorize WorkBuddy. You can still read connections, refresh authorization or disconnect locally.
workbuddy-connections.desktop_manual: Cannot access the clipboard. The platform address is selected; copy it manually and open it in your system browser.
workbuddy-connections.desktop_unavailabl: The current platform address is unavailable. Ask an administrator for its browser address, then open it in your system browser and sign in.
workbuddy-connections.invalid_response: The response does not match the current project, account or supported format. Read the current status before continuing.
workbuddy-connections.unknown: The operation outcome is unknown. Read its current status or recover the original operation. Recovery keeps its original account, version and operation ID.
workbuddy-connections.pending: The original operation is awaiting confirmation. Keep this page open until its receipt is recorded.
workbuddy-connections.access_lost: Access to this project or account is no longer available. Protected details have been hidden.
workbuddy-connections.setup_contact: Share the setup requirements below with your suma deployment administrator. Refresh the list after setup to connect your account.
workbuddy-connections.setup_requirements: Register an app in the WorkBuddy open platform. Register your public suma address plus the path below as the OAuth callback, then set the app ID, app secret and permitted scopes on the suma server.
workbuddy-connections.scopes_hint: Select the permissions to request. Preparing a link does not complete authorization or enable task dispatch.
workbuddy-connections.ready_hint: Open the official WorkBuddy page to review and approve permissions. We check the result when you return to this window. You can also check manually.
workbuddy-connections.authorization_comp: WorkBuddy account authorization was saved. Check cloud task permissions and execution eligibility in the corresponding task or run.
workbuddy-connections.authorization_pend: WorkBuddy authorization is still pending. Use the original link to finish authorization.
workbuddy-connections.authorization_chan: The account status changed. Read the current list before choosing another action.
workbuddy-connections.link_expired: The authorization link expired. Read the current status before requesting a new authorization.
workbuddy-connections.authorization_reco: The original authorization operation was recovered. Read the account status. A previous private link cannot be displayed again.
workbuddy-connections.refreshed_notice: The authorization refresh was recorded. Account authorization does not enable task dispatch.
workbuddy-connections.disconnected_notic: The connection was disabled locally. Remote access and remote tasks were not revoked or stopped.
workbuddy-connections.status_checked: The original account status was read. This does not acknowledge an unknown operation or create a new one.
workbuddy-connections.records_scope: Groups cover this page and any explicitly located connection, not every account in the project.
workbuddy-connections.retained_history: Disconnected connections retain their records and related task and run evidence. Local disconnection does not revoke WorkBuddy access or stop remote tasks.
workbuddy-connections.reason.effect_unkn: The authorization or refresh outcome is unconfirmed. Read the current status and recover the original operation when one is retained. Do not treat a timeout as a failed request and submit again.
workbuddy-connections.reason.reauthoriza: The original authorization needs confirmation again. Review the currently requestable permissions and explicitly select them before authorizing again.
workbuddy-connections.reason.generic: The connection needs attention. Read its current status and review the currently allowed actions.
workbuddy-connections.reuse_permissions_: Select only original permissions that are still requestable. Newly available permissions are not selected. You can adjust the selection manually.
workbuddy-connections.permission_changes: Compare the original grant with your selection. These are proposed changes; the actual grant is determined by the authorization result.
workbuddy-connections.permissions_unavai: These permissions are outside the current requestable scope and will not be selected when reusing permissions. Reauthorization does not automatically add other permissions.
workbuddy-connections.replace_link_hint: Submitting replaces the old link for this connection. Choose the permissions you want to request.
workbuddy-connections.disconnect_warning: Local disconnection prevents further use of this connection in Suma. It does not revoke access at WorkBuddy or stop remote tasks.
workbuddy-connections.disconnect_confirm: I understand that this only disables the local connection.
workbuddy-connections.empty_hint: Connect your account and choose which WorkBuddy permissions to grant to suma.
workbuddy-connections.read_only_hint: You can view your own connections. Connecting an account requires write access to this project.
